handoff.summary: Irregular proven primes above UWORD_MAX now continue from the identity equation lattice through the bounded exact Buchmann--Lenstra p-radical/multiplier cycle. Construction and global certification independently replay the complete result, compare p-local discriminant valuation, preserve the regular polygon fast path, and never enter a word-prime matrix backend. The cubic (x+p)^3+p^4 at p=2^64+13 is frozen against Sage 10.9/PARI and differentially checked in CPython and Sage.js with basis, closure, index, discriminant, event, and fail-closed corruption coverage.
risks: The existing dynamic Buchmann--Lenstra degree and iteration limits remain deliberate fail-closed resource bounds; unsupported larger irregular cases still raise instead of returning an uncertified order.
